title: To be & to have
summary: Les deux verbes les plus fondamentaux de l'anglais.
lesson: To be : I am, you are, he/she/it is, we/you/they are. To have : I have, he/she/it has, we/you/they have. Forme négative : isn't, aren't, doesn't have, don't have.

questions.prompt: « He have a car » est correct.
